positions.description: Skills: React.js · Tailwind CSS · Chakra · JSON · TypeScript · Next.js

positions.title: Frontend Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed the new All Digital Access landing page using React (Javascript) and CSS modules to ensure mobile responsiveness and compatibility with the Times' other landing pages (Games, Cooking, Wirecutter, etc).
- Developed the Navbar, Menu, and Header components of the landing page in Storybook to maximize modularity and provide  documentation for those components.
- Developed automated UI snapshot tests for the landing page using Puppeteer and Jest. 
- Refactored the backend schema for storing automatic renewal terms and the frontend api calls made to retrieve those terms using Go, React (Typescript), and GraphQL.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed several API calls in Redux resulting in a 2x speed improvement in app responsiveness and within the user preferences section.
- Redesigned the UX for a preferences component during user sign-up and preference selection steps.
- Refactored core React components increasing code usability and readability.
- Implemented a text input component that is used in nearly every text input field of the app by designing the UI and developing it in React Native.

projects.title: DAOism
projects.description:
A system that allows for the creation and verification of employment contracts on the chain. Third parties can verify employment history trustlessly via a key, and aggregated salary data would be transparently available and verified by employers with Zero Knowledge Proofs.

Frontend Tech Stack: Next.JS (Typescript) + Chakra UI
